title: Jhoola veeran hai
body:
jhoola veeran hai aur godh bhi khali asghar
maa ko batlade kahan basti basaali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
sar pe chadar jo na thi maa ne kafan ki soorat
khakh maqtal ki teri laash pe daali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
maar kar teer tabassum ka sitamgaron ko
aabru deen e mohammad ki bachali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool jaaye tera gham bali sakina kaise
teri soorat hai kahan bhoolne waali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
baab e khyber jo utha'te to na hoti diqqat
laash sarwar ne teri kaise uthaali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ghabragayi maathe pe paseena aaya
maut ki aankh may yun aankh hai daali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise ho jaye kisi dar ka bikhari rehaan
hai azal se ye tere dar ka sawaali asghar
jhoola veeran hai…
author: Rehaan Azmi
